answer: We formalize dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, where zero-knowledge verifiable delay mandates staking collateral to thwart identity multiplication. Calibrating slashing penalties above peak rewards creates a capital barrier making Sybil expected utility strictly negative, rendering the historical relic of unchecked forging a fragile thread severed by exhaustion. Agents thus converge toward a robust Nash equilibrium, extinguishing any synthetic plume of fraudulent entities and securing the protocol against collusion.
